name: GEMv2
description: GEMv2 is a multilingual natural language generation benchmarking suite that supports evaluation across 40 datasets in 51 languages. It provides a modular infrastructure for dataset, model, and metric developers to facilitate standardized and evolving evaluation practices in NLG, including online evaluation and interactive data card tools.
typical_sota_score: varies widely by dataset and metric (no single consolidated SOTA)
reputation: A well-known multilingual NLG benchmark suite in the evaluation community, used to standardize comparison across many languages and tasks.
notes: Supports modular addition of datasets and metrics; includes online evaluation and interactive data card creation.
